name: Weight
label: Weight
meaning: How heavy the item is. Packed items read in grams, so 20000 means 20 kg.

name: MaxQuantity
label: Stack size
meaning: How many of the item fit in one inventory slot. It lives on the item's Stackable part, not the item itself.

name: MaxStackSize
label: Max stack
meaning: The most of the item that can sit in one stack.

name: MaxContainedWeight
label: Max contained weight
meaning: The most weight this container can hold.

name: MaxWaterWeightRatio
label: Water ratio
meaning: How much water the item holds for its weight (bottles and containers).

name: CanBecomeBadQuality
label: Can spoil
meaning: Whether the item can spoil or go bad over time.

name: IsMergeable
label: Mergeable
meaning: Whether stacks of this item can be merged together.

name: ShelfLife
label: Spoil time
meaning: How long food lasts before it spoils. It counts down only while you are in game. No value means it never spoils.

name: _autoDestructTime
label: Auto-destruct time
meaning: This controls how long an item left on the ground or on a surface (like a table) lasts before it vanishes. If you want it to stay permanently, set it to 0. It counts only while you are away from it or logged out.

name: MaxHealth
label: Health
meaning: The item's health (how much wear it takes before it breaks).

name: MaxRadiationAmountPerWeight
label: Radiation per weight
meaning: How much radiation the item gives off for its weight.

name: GridInventoryRowSpan
label: Height in grid
meaning: How many grid rows the item takes up in the inventory.

name: GridInventoryColumnSpan
label: Width in grid
meaning: How many grid columns the item takes up in the inventory.

name: GridInventorySortGroup.TagName
label: Category
meaning: The item's category tag (for example ItemSortGroup.Food.Solid). The game matches this name exactly.

name: Caption
label: Name
meaning: The item's shown name. Change it on the Name & description card — the words are written onto your own copy.

name: Description
label: Description
meaning: The item's description. Change it on the Name & description card — a borrowed description is rewritten as plain words, so the game shows yours.

name: Actor
label: World object
meaning: A link to the blueprint this item becomes in the world.

name: NumRows
label: Container height
meaning: How many grid rows the item's own container has.

name: NumColumns
label: Container width
meaning: How many grid columns the item's own container has.

name: CanContainNonEmptyEntries
label: Hold non-empty items
meaning: Whether the container may hold items that are not empty.

name: HasContainedWeightLimit
label: Has a weight limit
meaning: Whether the contained-weight limit applies.

name: MaxResourceAmount
label: Resource capacity
meaning: How much of the resource the item can hold.

name: ResourceAmount
label: Resource it starts with
meaning: How much of the resource the item holds to begin with.

name: ExtendedBounds.SphereRadius
label: Interaction radius
meaning: The radius of the item's extra interaction bounds.
